sources.roll: PDS Voyager ISS SEDR CK with NAIF pck00011, evaluated at exposure end
sources.imageScale: GEOMED detached PDS label pixel FOV; distortion-corrected 1000x1000 grid

method: Body-frame vectors and camera roll are source-derived. Only image-center translation is refined against sunlit shape-limb gradients. No mesh vertices or source terrain are edited. Photometric background offset is the median of the recorded empty-sky region.
limitations: SEDR pointing is uncorrected. The Stooke model is coarse and can exaggerate facets or depressions; image registration is approximate at that shape accuracy, not a modern photogrammetric solution.

registration.method: SEDR roll and OPUS viewing geometry; pointing translation fitted to sunlit shape-limb gradients
